Package dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.event

Enum Class CubismOperation

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Enum<CubismOperation>
dev.turboism.sdk.cubism.event.CubismOperation
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Comparable<CubismOperation>, Constable
public enum CubismOperation extends Enum<CubismOperation>
Typed catalog of Cubism model and Editor operations that may emit a before -> invoke -> on -> after lifecycle.

The identifiers are Turboism semantics. They never expose host class or method names.

A catalog entry does not enable a host hook or claim host-version support; only a verified runtime producer may emit it.
